blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Thornhill was little changed, 8 in June and 8 in September (+0.0%), and 2 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.8% of Maple Ridge’s 286 condos and townhomes listed.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Thornhill?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 8 condos and townhomes listed in Thornhill. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Thornhill a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Thornhill had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Thornhill from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 condos and townhomes sold in Thornhill over those 4 months, out of 184 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Thornhill sell for?
faq.a: 7 townhomes sold in Thornhill between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $862,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Thornhill?
faq.a: The median was 19 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 99.3% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
